parameters.query:
select tc.id as tc_id,
       tc.client_message, tc.coach_message, tc.ideal_response,
       tc.conversation_note, tc.client_state, tc.response_type,
       tc.interaction_type, tc.tagged_techniques, tc.transcript_id,
       t.title, t.created_at::date as session_date,
       case
         when t.title ~* 'jaffe|deep dive' then 'adi_deep_dive'
         when t.title ~* '^tuesday' then 'adi_tuesday'
         when t.title ~* $$\mmen'?s\M$$ and t.title !~* 'women' then 'mens_group'
         when t.title ~* '^(mon|tues|wednes|thurs|fri|satur|sun)day' then 'group'
         else 'one_on_one'
       end as session_kind
from transcript_conversations tc
join transcripts t on t.id = tc.transcript_id
where length(coalesce(tc.client_message,'')) >= 40
  and length(coalesce(tc.coach_message,'')) >= 60
  and coalesce(t.title,'') !~* 'onboarding'
  and (
        t.title ~* 'jaffe|deep dive'
     or t.title ~* '^(mon|tues|wednes|thurs|fri|satur|sun)day'
     or (t.title ~* $$\mmen'?s\M$$ and t.title !~* 'women')
  )
order by case
           when t.title ~* 'jaffe|deep dive' then 0
           when t.title ~* '^tuesday' then 1
           else 2
         end,
         t.created_at desc
limit 5000;

select coalesce(json_agg(distinct metadata->>'tc_id'), '[]'::json) as ingested
from sparky_segments;
